title: Florida House, District 50
what_it_does: Represents District 50 in the Florida House of Representatives; votes on state laws and the state budget.
decided_note: Incumbent Republican Jennifer Canady faces Carlos Gamez on Nov. 3, 2026. Gamez's party affiliation was not stated in the search snippet.
verified_ballot_note: Ballotpedia's Canady page: 'Incumbent Jennifer Canady and Carlos Gamez are running in the general election for Florida House of Representatives District 50 on November 3, 2026' (https://ballotpedia.org/Jennifer_Canady). Research limitation: every WebFetch (Ballotpedia, Wikipedia, Division of Elections, county SOEs, news sites) was blocked and the search budget was capped, so this roster comes only from search-result snippets and should be re-verified against the county Supervisor of Elections sample ballot.
